capabilities: Spaces top-level prose paragraphs from soft breaks
Separates standalone image lines inside top-level quotes
Shows theme-matching markers for second- and third-level ordered lists in Live Preview
Preserves original Markdown numbers and existing paragraph nodes
Rebuilds Reading views when the theme switches or the plugin disables
disambiguation: Not a theme or Markdown editor; it only changes display while Newsprint by Camus is active and never writes notes.
extras: Manual GitHub installation (community directory submission pending); no network requests, data collection, or note writes; verified on macOS, mobile and Windows untested.
intentEvidence: Optional companion for Newsprint by Camus.
problem: Vaults that keep Markdown compact without blank lines between paragraphs get run-on prose in Reading view and Live Preview, and fixing it would mean editing every note.

relations.evidence: Optional companion for Newsprint by Camus.

summary: Display companion for the Newsprint by Camus theme that renders compact prose soft breaks as spaced paragraphs without editing Markdown.
